name: myLen_map
prelude:
def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1
statement: theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myLen, ih]
  have len_a (zs : List α) : myLen zs = zs.length := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myLen, ih]
  have len_b (zs : List β) : myLen zs = zs.length := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myLen, ih]
  rw [len_b, len_a, List.length_map]
strategies: Prove length characterizations at both element types and use length_map.
